title: MVCC: an update adds a version, so an older snapshot keeps reading the old one
caption: T2 and T3 never wait for each other. Visibility is decided by xmin / xmax and each transaction's snapshot.

messages.label: BEGIN → snapshot {1}
messages.note: T2's snapshot: only transaction 1 (which loaded a = 10) has committed.

messages.label: UPDATE a = 20
messages.note: T3 stamps xmax = 3 on the old version [a=10 xmin=1] and appends a new one [a=20 xmin=3 xmax=0]. No lock blocks T2.

messages.label: COMMIT
messages.note: Commit only marks txid 3 as committed. No rows are copied.

messages.label: a = 10
messages.note: Txid 3 isn't in T2's snapshot, so the new version is invisible and its xmax doesn't count: T2 still sees 10 (repeatable read).

messages.label: a = 20
messages.note: T4 started after 3 committed: it sees the new version. The old one is now dead and waits for VACUUM.
